_comment: Source of truth for the PROD vLLM serverless endpoint — created at the prod cutover, never before. Values are supplied at creation time; this file is the record of what prod must be.
name: vllm-ministral-prod
gpu_tier: ONLY L4 / RTX 4090 / RTX 4000 Ada — enforce via console GPU checkboxes (REST list gets widened to the whole 24GB tier incl. MIG slices, which OOM on load). Compilation stays ON: the small-RAM hosts it once guarded against are excluded by the GPU pinning, and eager mode measured ~7x slower generation (11 tok/s on RTX 4000 Ada, 2026-07-20).

env.HF_TOKEN: supplied at creation from the operator's secret store — never written into this file

_privacy: PRIVACY-LOAD-BEARING: DISABLE_LOG_REQUESTS must be True in prod and must never be removed. Without it, vLLM logs every request body — the decrypted member health envelope — into RunPod's persistent log storage, which outlives the ephemeral worker and breaks the PIE guarantee that decrypted data exists only in worker memory for ~5 minutes. Dev (endpoint.dev.json) deliberately keeps logging ON because dev carries synthetic test data only; that choice must never be copied to prod.
_licensing: Ministral 3 (2512) family is Apache 2.0 — usable commercially. Do NOT substitute Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410: it is Mistral Research License (non-commercial).
_request_surface: OpenAI-compatible: https://api.runpod.ai/v2/<ENDPOINT_ID>/openai/v1/chat/completions with a Bearer key. Workers use a RESTRICTED endpoint-invocation-only key, never the account key.
